name: RAPID INSERTION
text: Turning point 1 only, no CP: each friendly Trooper in the killzone wholly within your drop zone may take a free Reposition that ends wholly within 3 inches of your drop zone.

name: DROP INSERTION
text: Turning points 1 and 2, no CP: move each of your Drop markers up to 4 inches horizontally.

name: SUDDEN OFFENSIVE
text: Halve (round up) the number of your Tempestus Aquilons that are not incapacitated, those above included: the first that many Aquilons you activate this turning point have Balanced on all their weapons for that activation.

name: MAINTAIN MOMENTUM
text: This turning point, a friendly Tempestus Aquilon that shoots, or fights in its own Fight action, against a ready enemy has Severe on its weapons.

name: EYE ABOVE
text: Pick an enemy in the killzone: it and every enemy within 3 inches of it get your Detected token until the end of the turning point. When a Detected enemy shoots a friendly Tempestus Aquilon you may re-roll one defence die; when it fights or retaliates against one, one of your blocks cancels two unresolved successes instead of one.

name: DROP AND SECURE
text: Pick an objective or mission marker. Until the Ready step of the next turning point, your contesting total there counts 1 higher while a friendly Tempestus Aquilon contests it, and friendly Tempestus Aquilons within 3 inches of it have Atk +1 on melee weapons, to a maximum of 4.

name: HOT DROP
text: After rolling attack dice for a friendly Tempestus Aquilon that is wholly within your opponent's territory, or that landed or dropped from Vantage terrain at least 2 inches up in this activation: if the target is within 6 inches, re-roll any of your attack dice.

name: ADJUST COORDINATES
text: When a friendly Tempestus Aquilon lands, it may be set up within 5 inches (horizontally) of a Drop marker instead of 3 (or 4). For the rest of the turning point it cannot Dash, Shoot or Fight.

name: TEMPESTUS EXEMPLARS
text: During the activation of a friendly Tempestus Aquilon that is not the Servo-Sentry and whose APL is not above 2: Pick Up Marker, Place Marker and mission actions cost it 1 AP less, never below 0.

name: PROGENA
text: When a friendly Tempestus Aquilon other than the Servo-Sentry is activated: it regains up to 2D3 lost wounds, and every change to its APL is ignored for that activation.
